add.title: Add an area
add.description: What do you care about? An area is broad, like Fundraising or Hiring. Nobody owns it and it has no deadline; the responsibilities you own sit under it.

rename.title: Rename area
rename.description: Everyone in the company sees the new name.

archive.title: Archive {{title}}?
archive.description: It is archived for everyone in the company, and nothing new can be filed under it.
archive.ownedHere_one: Your responsibility in it stays there until you move it to another area.
archive.ownedHere_other: Your {{count}} responsibilities in it stay there until you move them to another area.
